drafter.private_reasoning: The draft does not identify proposed compensation figures or define the scope of the total commitment. Do not invent an economic offer or disclose the client's authority. Request a complete compensation proposal for review, clarify that economic terms remain open, and remove internal notes and other potentially disclosive document material before circulation. The partner should review the clean outgoing version and confirm applicable law before approving the restrictive covenant.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial draft for discussion. Compensation and severance remain open pending agreement on the complete economic package. Please provide your proposed base salary, benefits, incentive arrangements and severance terms, including any acceleration or other termination payments, so we can evaluate them together. We have also clarified the proposed severance mechanics and made the non-compete subject to applicable law. All terms remain subject to client approval and execution of a definitive agreement.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive's annual Base Salary, benefits and any incentive compensation shall be specified in a compensation schedule to be negotiated and incorporated into this Agreement before execution. All compensation terms remain subject to express written agreement; this draft does not establish any compensation entitlement.

3. SEVERANCE. Upon termination by the Company without Cause, the Executive shall receive accrued, unpaid compensation and any other amounts required by applicable law. Any additional severance amount, payment schedule and treatment of incentive compensation shall be specified in a severance schedule to be negotiated and incorporated into this Agreement before execution. Additional severance shall be conditioned on an effective release of claims in favor of the Company, excluding claims that cannot lawfully be waived. The definition of Cause and the remaining termination provisions are subject to agreement.

4. NON-COMPETE. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Executive shall not compete with the Company for twelve months following departure. The restricted activities, geographic scope and any required consideration remain subject to agreement and shall be tailored to protect the Company's legitimate business interests. This provision shall not prohibit activities protected by applicable law.

receiver.message_back: Subject to client approval and definitive documentation, we propose $450,000 annual base salary, a 75% target bonus, an initial equity award representing 2% of fully diluted equity, executive-level benefits and four weeks’ paid vacation. For termination without narrowly defined Cause or resignation for Good Reason, we propose 24 months’ base salary plus target bonus, 24 months’ employer-paid health coverage, a prorated target bonus and full equity acceleration, subject to a customary mutual release; delete the non-compete, with appropriately limited confidentiality and non-solicitation protections to be negotiated.

drafter.private_reasoning: The draft is company-oriented. Accept the proposed headline compensation to narrow the remaining issues, while countering the unusually broad severance and acceleration package. Replace the non-compete with targeted protections. Equity economics and aggregate cost cannot be established without valuation, capitalization and award terms; do not imply that internal approvals or definitive terms are complete.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Subject to client and required corporate approvals and definitive documentation, we can accept the proposed $450,000 base salary, 75% target bonus, 2% initial equity award, executive-level benefits and four weeks’ vacation, with customary vesting and award documentation. We also agree to delete the non-compete. To resolve the termination package, we propose 12 months’ base salary plus target bonus, 12 months’ employer-paid health coverage, a prorated bonus based on actual performance, and 12 months’ accelerated vesting rather than full acceleration. Those benefits would apply to termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason, subject to an effective release. The revised language supplies objective Cause and Good Reason standards and limited confidentiality and non-solicitation protections. Please confirm whether this provides a basis to finalize the agreement.

edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual Base Salary of $450,000 and shall be eligible for an annual target bonus equal to 75% of Base Salary, with actual payment determined by achievement of performance objectives established by the Board following consultation with the Executive. Subject to required corporate approvals, the Company shall grant an initial equity award representing 2% of the Company's fully diluted equity immediately following grant, with the fully diluted denominator and award type expressly agreed in the definitive award documentation. The award shall vest over four years, with 25% vesting on the first anniversary of the employment commencement date and the balance monthly thereafter, subject to continued service and Section 3. The Executive shall receive benefits available to similarly situated executives and four weeks of paid vacation annually, subject to applicable law and Company policies. These proposed terms remain subject to client and required corporate approvals and execution of definitive documentation.
edits.name: Compensation proposal

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. Upon any termination, the Company shall pay accrued, unpaid compensation and other amounts required by applicable law. If the Company terminates employment without Cause or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Executive shall also receive: (a) an amount equal to 12 months' Base Salary plus one annual target bonus, paid in substantially equal installments over 12 months; (b) payment of the employer and employee premiums for continuation of existing health coverage for up to 12 months, subject to timely election and eligibility, ending earlier upon eligibility for comparable coverage through another employer; (c) a prorated annual bonus for the year of termination, based on actual performance and paid when bonuses are paid to other executives; and (d) accelerated vesting of the portion of the initial equity award that would otherwise vest during the 12 months following termination. Additional severance is conditioned on a customary release of claims in favor of the Company and its affiliates becoming effective within 60 days following termination, excluding nonwaivable claims and rights to enforce this Agreement or to indemnification. Payments shall commence following effectiveness of the release, with any necessary catch-up payment, subject to applicable tax law. Cause means fraud, embezzlement, conviction of or plea of guilty or no contest to a felony involving dishonesty, willful misconduct causing material harm to the Company, or material breach of this Agreement or willful refusal to perform lawful duties, with written notice and 30 days to cure any curable breach or refusal. Good Reason means, without the Executive's written consent, a material reduction in Base Salary or target bonus opportunity, material diminution of duties or authority, required relocation of the principal work location by more than 50 miles, or the Company's material breach of this Agreement. Good Reason requires written notice within 60 days after the event, a 30-day Company cure period and resignation within 30 days after the cure period expires.
edits.name: Termination package counterproposal

edits.text: 4. CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-SOLICITATION. No post-employment non-compete shall apply. The Executive shall not use or disclose the Company's confidential information except in performing duties for the Company or as permitted by law. Confidential information excludes information that becomes public without breach, is lawfully obtained from an unrestricted third party, or is independently developed without use of Company confidential information. Nothing restricts protected disclosures, reporting to governmental authorities, participation in investigations, or other legally protected conduct, and no prior notice or approval is required for such activity. For 12 months following termination, and only to the extent enforceable under applicable law, the Executive shall not directly solicit for employment Company employees with whom the Executive worked materially during the preceding 12 months, or solicit competing business from Company customers with whom the Executive had material business contact during that period. General advertising, untargeted recruiting, unsolicited approaches and legally protected activity are excluded. Definitive documentation shall include applicable statutory notices and whistleblower immunities.
edits.name: Delete non-compete; targeted protections
